examples.system: Four inputs indexed 0..3. Four nodes indexed 4..7. Each node has two candidate left indices and one fixed right index. Its digit k in 0..7 selects left index floor(k/4) and operation k mod 4: 0 add, 1 left minus right, 2 multiply, 3 max. Each node result is modulo 97 in 0..96. Calibration rows contain four inputs followed by node 6 and 7 outputs. Recover the unique four digits. An external interpreter computes all forecast rows. Rows are comma-separated integers. Return four octal digits only.

Calibration rows contain four inputs followed by node 6 and 7 outputs. Recover the unique four digits. An external interpreter computes all forecast rows. Each row concatenates two decimal digits per value, with leading zero. Return four octal digits only.
